decision.what: Grounds reuse tone.js's four-name band set (surface/wash/prim/dark) at card scale instead of inventing new names
decision.why: styles/sections/tone.js already proved the exact same four grounds, including the always-dark-island trick for dark/prim, for a full-width band; a card needed the same four, just smaller
decision.alternative: hand-pick a fifth neutral grey, rejected — the owner's words named exactly four

decision.what: Nesting depth is set in JS (nesting/page.js's level() function stamps card-level-N), not a pure CSS :is() selector
decision.why: a CSS selector can say 'exactly 4 cards deep' but not 'level 4 and EVERY level after it' without one hand-written rule per depth; card/log/LogView.js already made the identical call for a log group
decision.alternative: a `.card .card .card .card` chain, rejected — doc/system.md has the reasoning

decision.what: Mini pages: a card's data is a `{"card": {...}}` line in page.jsonl, read by a custom Page subclass (MiniPages.js) named via the jsonl format's own "class" field; route() answers any slug the lines named
decision.why: the owner's 8:40pm decision — no folder per card; core/Page/Log.js's own comment says a Page subclass adds a page.jsonl word by adding a method, which is exactly what `card()` does
decision.alternative: none — this is the mechanism core/Page/dynamic/ and core/Page/jsonl/ were pointing at together
